what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted 3-0 to have the land use director write a letter to the zoning board summarizing its points on the Pond View Commons 40B, reviewed by two members first.
Most of the meeting went to the Pond View Commons waiver requests, including waivers of Arrow Estates subdivision conditions and of road surety, with questions left for town counsel.
The land use director will ask town counsel whether the applicant-definition waiver and the other waivers apply only within the comprehensive permit area.
The board approved the ANR for 245 Holman Street lots three and four, 4-0.
The board then approved a revised stormwater permit for 245 Holman Street, 4-0, carrying forward all conditions from the earlier decision.

why_it_matters: The Planning Board's letter is advice to the zoning board, which decides the Pond View Commons comprehensive permit, so waivers of subdivision rules such as road surety bear on who carries the cost of road and infrastructure risk if a build-out stalls.

Staff also plan to tell the Lufa Farms developer early about the town's wish for a parcel and park access easement, and the developer may seek a PILOT or TIF, which would affect the property tax revenue that project brings in.
watch_next: The board's next meeting is in four weeks, with the warrant article hearing, because the next scheduled meeting is skipped for the holiday.
Town counsel's answer on whether the waivers apply only within the comp permit area, and the comment letter to the zoning board.
